notes.title: Cubiverse Demo for Steam Next Fest & Release Date Announcement
notes.notes:
Hello cubinauts! 

We are very happy to share exciting news with you: 

To celebrate Steam Next Fest, we are [b]launching a demo for Cubiverse[/b] for the first time! 
And because we don't want the fun to end, Cubiverse is [b]releasing as a full game on the 7th of October at 6PM CET / 9AM PT[/b]! 

Please check out our demo and wishlist our game, that really helps us out a lot! And if you like the demo, please consider telling your friends about Cubiverse.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1680310/Cubiverse/?beta=0

Have fun puzzling!
[i]- Team Cubinauts[/i]
